issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor: The problem statement's UML (problem_statement.md line 72) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type double, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 85) declares and implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and causes integer division/truncation in the solution (losing fractional students per tutor), which contradicts the UML contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the UML: change the method signature in Lecture.java to 'public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()' and compute the value using floating-point division, e.g. 'return getTotalNumberOfStudents() / (double) getNumberOfTutors();'. Alternatively, if integer result was intended, update the UML in problem_statement.md to use int and document integer division behavior. Ensure template and tests reflect the chosen return type.
